title: Gusseted bracket
prompt:
All dimensions are millimetres. Build exactly what is described — no fillets, chamfers, draft or extra features unless the description asks for them. Leave the finished part in the document; do not export anything.

A gusseted bracket, one solid piece:
- a base 90 along X, 50 along Y, 8 thick along Z, corner at the origin,
  extending into +X, +Y, +Z;
- an upright wall 8 thick occupying X from 0 to 8 and the full 50 of Y, rising
  to a total height of 60 in Z;
- a triangular gusset 6 thick, centred on the width so it spans Y from 22 to
  28, filling the inside corner between them: a right triangle whose legs run
  40 along X from the wall face at X=8, and 40 up Z from the base face at
  Z=8, with the sloped edge running from (X=48, Z=8) to (X=8, Z=48).

checks.why: the sloped gusset face exists and is actually sloped
